answer:
Check the delivery location shown, with household members, building reception, or the parcel area, to ensure the parcel was left at the correct address. [Source 1]

If the parcel is still missing, review the carrier's delivery notes or photo if available to verify the delivery details. [Source 1]

If the parcel is still missing, contact support with your order number and the delivery date to create a case and request assistance. [Source 1]

A refund or replacement is not automatic for a missing parcel, and support will need to investigate further to determine the next steps. [Source 1]

answer:
Unfortunately, after an order has shipped, it is generally not possible to cancel it. [Source 1]

However, if you contact us before the item is delivered, we may be able to assist you with a return or exchange. [Source 1]

If you have received the item and would like to return it, please follow the return process through our support channel. [Source 2]

Please note that we cannot guarantee that a cancellation will be accepted after the item has shipped. [Source 1]
